title: Element Format Examples for EBT Program Data
applicability: Applies to eBT/eWIC Segment 103 Element 164 EBT Program Data associated with Segment 100 transactions.

businessRequirements.title: EBT Program Data Element 164 shall begin with a three-digit zero-filled total length matching all following program-data characters.
Each EBT Program Data subelement shall contain a valid tag, length, and detail payload whose length matches the declared length.
HIP purchase/return program data shall use the source-defined account type, amount type, currency, descriptor, and zero-filled amount detail.
Element 164 shall support multiple valid program-data subelements with a total length covering all subelements.

testCases.positive: Valid HIP program data with matching total length
HIP amount and IT shipping subelements have matching combined length
negative: Second subelement omitted from total length
